The deck focuses on aggressive plays with Eldrazi creatures and disrupts opponents with Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control the board with cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Kozilek's Command. The mana base is designed to consistently cast Eldrazi creatures and utilize colorless spells, with lands like Ancient Tomb and Eldrazi Temple. The goal is to apply pressure early and maintain board control to secure a win.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value through cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Narset, Parter of Veils. The inclusion of cards like Prismatic Ending and Supreme Verdict allows for versatile removal options, while Teferi, Time Raveler can provide additional disruption. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key pieces and maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent in a slower-paced game.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt opponents' strategies by playing early game lock pieces like Trinisphere and Blood Moon, while also quickly putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Pyrogoyf. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption, while also using burn spells like Shatterskull Smashing to finish off opponents. The mana base is focused on fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, allowing for explosive starts and powerful plays.

The main idea of this deck is to use control elements like Stifle, Force of Will, and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt your opponent's game plan while utilizing the powerful combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Abhorrent Oculus to quickly finish the game. Curie, Emergent Intelligence and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and additional control options. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder for consistency and deck manipulation, along with lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and win through a powerful combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently tutor for specific creatures and combo pieces using cards like Natural Order, Chord of Calling, and Green Sun's Zenith in order to quickly assemble a powerful board state. By utilizing cards like Nadu, Winged Wisdom, Springheart Nantuko, Nomads en-Kor, and Allosaurus Shepherd, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature synergy and mana acceleration from Gaea's Cradle. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Endurance helps to control the game and protect the combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, then use Show and Tell to put a big threat like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn into play for free. With cards like Omniscience and Sneak Attack, the deck can gain a huge advantage by putting powerful creatures into play without paying their mana cost. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly bring powerful creatures back into play through reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By using cards like Entomb to put key creatures into the graveyard and combining it with powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Daze, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent while setting up explosive plays with high-impact creatures. The deck aims to efficiently reanimate creatures such as Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while also deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes efficient card draw with Brainstorm and Ponder, along with countermagic in the form of Force of Will and Daze to protect its threats. The mana base is optimized for consistent access to both blue and black mana sources, with Wasteland included to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

This deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces such as Nomads en-Kor, Nadu, Winged Wisdom, and Springheart Nantuko to generate infinite creature mana and card draw. By using cards like Birds of Paradise and Noble Hierarch for ramp, and Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling for creature tutor, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn. Additionally, cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Collector Ouphe provide disruption against opposing strategies, while Natural Order and Craterhoof Behemoth offer an alternate win condition through overwhelming board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back onto the battlefield, bypassing their casting cost. This allows for explosive plays and can overwhelm opponents with big threats early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Brazen Borrower and Fatal Push to control the board and disruptive spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win through a combination of powerful reanimated creatures and controlling the opponent's board state.
